Cc: partners@sparkcloud.io
Date: Mon, 4 May 2026 09:17:00 -0700
Subject: Redwood listing inquiry — quick intro & demo

Hi Ava,

We noticed Redwood on the cloud marketplace and our infra team is evaluating inference options — low-latency serving and deterministic RBAC are top priorities for our workloads. I set up a quick test run against a sample trace; attaching the event log and a short overview of our use case.

Would love to arrange a 30‑minute intro + walkthrough to see where Redwood fits and get a sense for pricing and deployment options (hosted vs private). Our CTO, Maya Patel, will join if possible.

Possible windows (PDT): Tue 5/5 10–12, Wed 5/6 14–16, Thu 5/7 9–11. Any of those work for your team?

Thanks —
Alex Moreno
Head of Infrastructure, SparkCloud
alex.moreno@sparkcloud.io
attachments: sparkcloud-event-log.csv, product-overview.pdf

Hi Alex — great to hear from you and thanks for sending the log. I can take point on the intro call and will loop in Priyom (AE) to cover procurement and sizing.

Agenda suggestion (30 min):
- 5m intros & goals
- 10m quick architecture walkthrough (serving modes + deployment options)
- 10m focused on latency/cost tradeoffs using your trace
- 5m next steps (trial, PO/contract paths)

I’m available Wed 5/6 14:00–14:30 PDT — that matches your preference. I’ll propose that slot unless you prefer a different one. If Maya prefers a different time, send a preferred window and we’ll adjust.
